verdict.rationale: Gusto is a payroll and fintech platform with a new business bank account, so international payments are a fair axis for it. However, nothing in the evidence documents sending international payments, local-currency payouts, FX, or transparent fee disclosure. The bank account and Money Dashboard items cover domestic account opening and cash-flow visibility only, so they are adjacent features that earn no credit.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can send international payments in local currencies with transparent fees
